# Native PDF golden fixture

**Purpose:** Describe the independent D18 PDF text/page oracle.

`native-pages.pdf` is a hand-assembled PDF 1.4 with explicit xref offsets, Helvetica text streams and a five-entry ToUnicode CMap; it is not generated by the extraction implementation or pypdf. There are no credentials, actions, annotations or external resources.

| Physical page (one-based) | Exact native text | Intent |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Page one: Alpha 123\nSecond line.` | Two text operations and line ordering |
| 2 | `Xin ệ` | Explicit Unicode mapping including U+1EC7, independent of host fonts |
| 3 | Empty string | Keep a page record and report `no_native_text` |

The short second-page string is a character-mapping probe, not a Vietnamese sentence. Empty extracted text does not prove visual emptiness; scanned/image-only pages need D21. Tests build encrypted, active, malformed, 1003-page and per-page/document text-overflow variants independently using pypdf's writer. Layout, arbitrary fonts and OCR accuracy are outside this golden's claims.
